question: A businessman marks up the price of his goods by 25% and gives a discount of 5% to the customer. He also uses a 950 gm weight instead of a 1000 gm weight. Find his overall profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Successive Ratio Method (CP : SP):

Markup of 25% ⇒ 4 : 5

Discount of 5% ⇒ 20 : 19

False weight (950g instead of 1000g) ⇒ 950 : 1000 = 19 : 20

Overall Ratio (CP : SP) = (4 × 20 × 19) : (5 × 19 × 20) = 4 : 5

Overall Profit % = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup = 25%, Discount = 5%, False weight = 950 gm, True weight = 1000 gm

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = [(SP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100
